entries.title: Breguet 521 Bizerte — historical reference drawing
entries.configuration: Breguet 521 Bizerte flying boat: three radial tractor engines, unequal biplane wings, stepped hull and stabilizing floats. Original independent plan and profile scales preserved; the profile shows overlapping engine stations. The source does not draw propeller blades.

source.author: Rama

source.modifications: Original geometry, annotations and colors preserved. Added an explicit 800 × 800 viewBox matching the original 600 pt browser viewport and an opaque white background. Displayed in grayscale by game UI. This adapted SVG remains under CC BY-SA 2.0 fr.

review.notes: Inspected original and adapted SVG at 300 px and 900 px. Original plan and profile retained with complete margins, readable outline and title; three engine stations, biplane hull and tail configuration match. Added viewport and white underlay do not transform original shapes. Grayscale display only. Original source omits propeller blades and uses independent view scales.

entries.title: CAMS 55/1 — source-based profile
entries.configuration: CAMS 55/1 reconnaissance flying boat: two inline Hispano-Suiza engines in a central tandem tractor/pusher installation, biplane wings, stepped boat hull, stabilizing wing floats and open pilot/gun positions. Original port profile of the early inline version. Far-side float overlaps the near float; beaching trolley omitted.

entries.title: Latécoère 523 — source-based profile
entries.configuration: Military Latécoère 523 with a two-deck stepped hull, high wing, stabilizing stub wings and terminal floats. Six inline engines: four tractors and two pushers; opposite engine stations overlap in true profile. Glazed military navigation bow and gun positions distinguish this original interpretation from the civil 521 reference. Equipment and panel details simplified.

entries.title: Lioré et Olivier H.257bis — source-based profile
entries.configuration: H.257bis maritime floatplane with two Gnome-Rhône radial tractor engines, two-bay biplane wings, two long stepped main floats, glazed pilot cabin and bow gun cupola. Port profile; opposite engine and float overlap. Represents the radial-engine float fit, not the inline H.258 or the later wheeled conversion. Crew positions inside the fuselage are not individually illustrated.

entries.title: Farman F.221 — source-based profile
entries.configuration: Production Farman F.221 heavy bomber: four cowled Gnome-Rhône radial engines in two tandem tractor/pusher pairs, high braced wing, rectangular deep fuselage, single fin, fixed main wheels and tail wheel. Enclosed bow and dorsal gun positions plus ventral position. Port profile; opposite nacelle overlaps. Distinct from the later retractable-gear F.222 and twin-fin F.223.
